verdict.rationale: Runway Dev documents a Playground for testing code, a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (confirmed by probe), and copy-paste cURL and SDK examples. These are the raw ingredients of an interactive, runnable reference, but the evidence never shows an API reference page whose examples can be executed in place. missing for 10: explicit interactive API reference with in-page runnable/try-it examples, detail on Playground scope, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can use the Playground to test your code, or follow the examples below to get started.
If you're not ready to start writing code, you can test the API with cURL.
